relationship_inspection.contact: Driver shaft meets the side-pivot center continuously. Rings around the head establish the axis location. The exposed flat tip and slot ends are still not visible, so contact is plausible but precise screw-slot engagement is not verified.
relationship_inspection.edges: All text and drawing are inside the canvas. Handle now has a complete round end. Right tool clearance is only about 20 native pixels, less than the requested ~5% width. No drawing line is cut. Inquiry has a small but visible bottom margin. Guarantee text ends close to the mirror upper-left rim, without visible collision.
relationship_inspection.action: Large blue deadline and full URL remain adjacent, easy to locate, and aligned with the main left copy edge. Their right edge leaves a region for the smaller mirror/driver.
relationship_inspection.whole_copy_relationship: Title and recruitment occupy less height and width than in the own initial. Bold blue schedule remains a strong middle group. Policy text now has visible semantic gaps instead of one uninterrupted run, and black normal policy text retains contrast against schedule/action. Blue application sits beside the smaller lower-right drawing; fee and inquiry continue below. The title and schedule weights remain heavier than planned. The long guarantee clause is still one readable line and is slightly tight to the mirror rim.
relationship_inspection.object_structure: Oval mirror, U-shaped support, pivot, stem, and round base are connected. The complete screwdriver now includes its handle end. Joint-head rings are visible but the working slot is obscured. Drawing is recognisable at 720 and 320.
relationship_inspection.finish: No new labels, logos, slogans, icons, fake microtext or watermark are visible. Black/blue language and cool light background persist. No overall score or quality certification is assigned.
